mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, application_id, knowledge_base_id, status FROM app_bound_knowledge_base WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND application_id = #{applicationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_bound_knowledge_base ( tenant_id, application_id, knowledge_base_id, status, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{applicationId}, #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{status}, #{tenantId}, #{tenantId} )
